lead_ja: バインミーに生春巻き、フォー、ブンチャー。ランチメニューも豊富でお手頃な、本格ベトナムレストランです。
lead_en: Banh mi, fresh spring rolls, pho and bun cha. A wide, affordable lunch menu at an authentic Vietnamese restaurant.

about_en: A clean, friendly room with Vietnamese music playing. Lunches you'll want to come back for, and dinner in the evening.
